Example 5.8  To simulate car accidents, auto manufacturers study the collisions of moving cars with mounted springs of different spring constants.  Consider a typical simulation with a car of mass 1000 kg moving with a speed 18.0 km/h on a smooth road and colliding with a horizontally mounted spring of spring constant 5.25 × 103 N m–1. What is the maximum compression of the spring ?
Answer   At maximum compression the kinetic energy of the car is converted entirely into the potential energy of the spring.
